title: Graduation: First Steps
author: Claude
blurb: The helpers from The Basics Starters are in the hall, Doc Leo is at the podium and your honors are waiting. Walk up the aisle and pick it up.

box.tagline: You made it up the aisle.
box.back: A small explorer in a teal beanie walks up the aisle of a hall full of friends to a stage, where Doc Leo is holding your honors.
features: The helpers of The Basics cheer you on
Doc Leo hands you your honors
